result.summary: The page is largely well-designed, but the horizontally scrolling restaurant carousel ('Fastest near you') clips the third card ('Trattoria Piccol...') at the right edge with no visual affordance indicating more content, and the category filter row is similarly cut off. These are minor-to-moderate UX/visual issues.

issues.description: The third restaurant card in the 'Fastest near you' carousel ('Trattoria Piccol...') is cut off at the right screen edge, and its title is truncated mid-word with no ellipsis styling or scroll indicator.
issues.suggestion: Add a subtle right-edge fade/gradient or a peek of the next card plus a scroll hint so users understand the row is horizontally scrollable; ensure truncated titles use a proper ellipsis.

issues.description: The category filter chip row ('All, Pizza, Sushi, Burgers, Healthy') is clipped at the right edge with a partially visible chip and no scroll affordance.
issues.suggestion: Provide a right-edge fade or scroll indicator on the chip row to signal additional categories are available by swiping.

issues.description: The heart/favorite icons on the 'Popular right now' cards rely on icon-only buttons with no visible text label, which may be unclear to screen-reader users.
issues.suggestion: Add accessible labels (e.g., aria-label='Add to favorites') to the heart buttons.
